nodes.label: Idea Capture
nodes.purpose: Preserve a raw market observation verbatim and open a governed Research Case before any strategy code exists. Capture is idempotent and grants no runner, strategy, holdout, paper, or execution authority.
inputs: A raw idea or observation, stated in the owner's words
outputs: A research case in phase 'captured' with an append-only governance record
limitations: Capture records the idea; it does not vet it — triage and the exploration contract do that
safe_change: CLI help text and projection formatting
Never: phase order, idempotent capture identity, authority grants

nodes.label: Research Case & Hypothesis Contract
nodes.purpose: Draft the bounded, falsifiable exploration contract (HypothesisCard) from the captured idea: competing explanations, scope, and the frozen analysis intent. Contracts are content-addressed (rc_<sha256>) and never overwritten — revisions create lineage.
outputs: A reviewable exploration contract awaiting owner approval
limitations: A drafted contract carries no execution authority until the owner approves it
safe_change: Proposal option bundles and drafting ergonomics
Never: contract content-addressing, review-event append-only ledger

nodes.label: Literature Discovery & Claims
nodes.purpose: Acquire scholarly sources through the isolated literature worker (the one research network surface) and turn them into anchored, owner-screened claims. Every stored object is content-addressed with a SourceReceipt labelled UNTRUSTED_SOURCE.
inputs: Search intents from the research case
outputs: Source records, receipts, extracted text, screened claims, frozen source packs
limitations: External text is untrusted input; claims gain standing only through owner screening
The worker runs in a scrubbed subprocess with rlimits; a non-zero exit fails loud
safe_change: Discovery query ergonomics and metadata parsing inside workers/literature
Never: the fail-closed acquisition primitives or the untrusted-source labelling

nodes.label: Dataset Registration & Data Audit
nodes.purpose: Bind the case to exact immutable data: register dataset refs (rd_<sha256>) fail-closed against snapshot-manifest bytes, then run the descriptive data audit as an immutable EXPLORATORY run before any hypothesis-specific analysis.
inputs: Snapshot manifests / crypto registrations / QuantPad receipts
outputs: Registered dataset refs and an audit run with descriptive analytics
limitations: Registration proves byte-identity, not data quality — the audit reports; it does not bless
safe_change: Additional descriptive analytics in alpha_research.descriptives
Never: the sha256 binding of refs to snapshot bytes, PIT access discipline

nodes.label: Contract Approval & Freeze
nodes.purpose: Owner approval freezes the exploration contract — analysis plan, topology, boundary, and implementation fingerprints — and advances the phase machine (strictly +1) into 'pilot'. Implementation drift after freeze is detected by hash comparison and fails loud.
outputs: A frozen contract and phase transition into the pilot stage
limitations: Approval is a trusted-local owner ceremony; it is deliberately absent from MCP
safe_change: Review-projection wording
Never: the strict phase order, the frozen-plan hashes, owner-only approval

nodes.label: D0 Synthetic Pilot
nodes.purpose: Prove the detector and power analysis on deterministic synthetic data before touching real market bars. The D0 power seed is protocol-frozen (never derived from AlphaSettings.random_seed) so acceptance is re-verified by exact recomputation on every reader.
outputs: An immutable EXPLORATORY run (evidence_zone D0) with d0_acceptance.json
limitations: D0 evidence is synthetic-only; it can never support a market claim
Changing any registered D0 constant is a breaking generation change (_D0_FIXTURE_VERSION)
safe_change: Report/chart presentation of pilot results
Never: the frozen power seed, fixture generation constants, acceptance recomputation

nodes.label: D1 Deep Research
nodes.purpose: Execute the frozen analysis plan strictly on the discovery share of real data (owner-CLI-launched only): conditional returns, rank IC, stability, lead-lag, and the frozen Holm secondary family. Evidence artifacts are content-hashed and mechanically re-verified at admission.
outputs: A D1 run (evidence_zone D1) with d1_analyses.json and gate evidence
limitations: D1 sees only the discovery share; readers never trust producer flags — evidence is recomputed
Launch is owner-CLI-only; the web/MCP surfaces can inspect but never launch with authority
safe_change: Additional D1 analysis families in alpha_research (pure, core-only, fail-loud)
Never: share topology, admission recomputation, launch authority

nodes.label: D2 One-Shot Confirmation
nodes.purpose: The sealed confirmation: owner approval authorizes the sealed share, the frozen primary reads it exactly once, and every admission and read re-verifies by exact recomputation. A pre-flight integrity failure contaminates the share (owner INVALID-only exit).
inputs: Frozen confirmation contract drawn from admitted D1 evidence
outputs: A REGISTERED CONFIRMATORY run with d2_analyses.json and gate evidence
limitations: One shot by construction — a consumed or contaminated share can never be re-read
D2 state machine: sealed → authorized → consumed | contaminated (append-only events)
safe_change: Presentation of confirmation findings
Never: one-shot semantics, contamination handling, boundary commitments

nodes.label: Owner Decision
nodes.purpose: Assemble the decision view — the fourteen-question spec-§10.1 edge-validation checklist (typed finding statuses or explicit NOT_TESTED, never a numeric aggregate), the readiness scorecard, and the terminal gate packet — and record the owner's disposition (advance/revise/park/reject) in the append-only decision ledger.
outputs: A recorded research decision and phase transition toward 'closed'
limitations: The checklist never aggregates into a single score — honest NOT_TESTED is a first-class answer
safe_change: Decision-view rendering on CLI/REST surfaces
Never: the fourteen-question contract, append-only decision events, owner-only authority

nodes.label: Strategy Promotion
nodes.purpose: When the owner decision is advance_to_strategy, record the lossless spec-§11 strategy_promotion dossier atomically inside the closing phase transition (HypothesisCard, gate-packet id+hash, registered datasets, screened claims, ledgers, verified chart references, open questions). The research gate then reads 'passed' and strategy creation unlocks.
outputs: strategy_promotion packet (cp_<sha256>) embedded in the strategy AgentBrief
limitations: The only unlinked path around this gate is an owner override, permanently watermarked on every run it touches
safe_change: AgentBrief rendering of the promotion reference
Never: atomic recording inside the closing transaction, gate-state derivation precedence

artifacts.label: Research case record
artifacts.description: Append-only project + governance rows opened at capture (SQLite control plane).

artifacts.label: Research contract
artifacts.description: Content-addressed rc_<sha256> hypothesis contract with review-event lineage.

artifacts.label: Source receipt
artifacts.description: Content-addressed SourceReceipt for an acquired document, labelled UNTRUSTED_SOURCE.

artifacts.label: Dataset registration
artifacts.description: rd_<sha256> ref bound fail-closed to exact snapshot-manifest bytes, plus audit records.

artifacts.label: Run manifest
artifacts.description: Immutable run directory manifest (schema v3): evidence_zone, watermark, snapshot hash, fingerprints; written last as the completion marker.

artifacts.label: Research gate evidence
artifacts.description: Content-hashed ResearchGateEvidenceV1 selectors; re-verified by exact recomputation on every read.

artifacts.label: Research gate packet
artifacts.description: Fail-closed terminal packet (packet_hash) assembled for closed cases.

artifacts.label: Strategy promotion dossier
artifacts.description: Lossless spec-§11 strategy_promotion packet recorded atomically at close.
